title: Mixed Event — Nocturne Interlude

meta.Outline: Toya has decided to create street music as a member of Vivid BAD SQUAD. But something happens to make him wonder if classical music still has some hold on him, leading to some self-doubt...

rows.Line: Street SEKAI
Crase Cafe

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: So I just wipe these cups and put them back on the shelf, MEIKO?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Yes, please.
You're always such a great help, Miku.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Huh? This cup...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: What's wrong?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
There's a crack in it...
Everything will just spill out.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Oh dear, you're right.
That's unfortunate. I really liked that cup.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Yeah...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: This is giving me a bad vibe for some reason...
Scramble Crossing

rows.Speaker: Passerby A
rows.Line:
Hey, check it out!
That guy's singing is awesome!

rows.Speaker: Passerby B
rows.Line:
Yeah... He's really good.
Does he always sing here?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Huff...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (I should finish up. It's getting quite late.)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (But I've been doing well lately. More people have been stopping by to listen to my performances too.)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (I've improved a lot ever since we formed our group.)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (Thinking more positively probably helped as well...)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
(Pursuing my dream with Akito...
I feel so much better after making that decision.)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (Now, all we have to do is keep moving forward.)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: But still...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (No... Dwelling on him won't solve anything.)
Aoyagi Household - Living Room
se_event_nocturne_2021_003

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I'm back...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
(The lights are still on?
That has to mean...)

rows.Speaker: Toya's Father
rows.Line: You're home late...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Dad...

rows.Speaker: Toya's Father
rows.Line: Just where exactly were you gallivanting around all this time?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
I wasn't playing around...
I was singing in front of the station.

rows.Speaker: Toya's Father
rows.Line: Exactly my point. Have you fallen so low that you no longer see what you are doing?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Ugh... I said I'm not playing around!
We're doing this to put on the ultimate event...

rows.Speaker: Toya's Father
rows.Line: How long do you plan on using such childish excuses to run away from your responsibilities?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I'm not running away!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: This is the path I've chosen!

rows.Speaker: Toya's Father
rows.Line: Path? Just where will this path lead you in the end?

rows.Speaker: Toya's Father
rows.Line: Remember, you were born to play classical music! Why can't you understand what I'm trying to do for you?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
I am not a child anymore!
I can decide for myself what I want to do!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
I'm never going back to classical music.
Street music is the only thing I'll be focusing on.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: So stay out of my life from now on!
se_event_nocturne_2021_004

rows.Speaker: Toya's Father
rows.Line: Toya!
se_event_nocturne_2021_001
Toya's Room

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: There...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Now, I can finally... Move forward...
Shibuya Park

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Okay, done with vocal warm-ups!
I'm ready to roll!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Same here.
You ready, Toya?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Ready.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
But she's still not here.
What's with her?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
You mean Azusawa?
She's usually here by now...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Hey, Kohane!
We just finished warming up and... Hm?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: What's wrong? You look pretty down.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Did something happen?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Yes... Um, sort of...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: You know that I've been taking part in battle events by myself to get used to being on stage, right?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Yeah! And the last one went really well too!
The crowd was super hyped up and everything.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
But why are you mentioning that now?
Did some weirdo try to hit on you?!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Oh, no!
Nothing like that...!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: It's just that one of my mom's friends saw me going into a live house the other day.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: And last night, my mom and dad told me to stop visiting dangerous places like that...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Oh, okay... Right. I guess those places can seem pretty sketchy if you're not familiar with how they work...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Ugh... Why're these geezers always so pigheaded?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: It's our life, they should just leave us alone.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Indeed...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: B-But even I thought they were scary at first, so I do understand where they're coming from...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: What should I do...?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Well, that's easy!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Our next show as a group is a battle event, right?
Get your mom and dad to come watch us!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: If they can see how much respect rival teams have for each other even during a battle event, they might see things differently!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
A picture is worth a thousand words, right?
Have them see things for themselves!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
(See things for themselves...
I hadn't thought of that, but...)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: And if they're still not convinced, I can talk to them with you! Oh, and maybe invite them to my dad's shop.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Oh, right...! We can do that too!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Yeah, watching an event themselves and meeting all of you will convince them that everything's totally safe, I'm sure of it!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (Azusawa's parents seem like the understanding type.)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I wish I could say the same...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Huh? You say something?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: No, it's nothing...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Since Kohane's dad may be coming to watch us, we've gotta practice harder and give it everything we've got!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Right!
Weekend Garage

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: So everyone's cool with this set list for our next event?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Yeah, I have no complaints. This is probably the best song order based on today's practice too.

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line:
Welcome! Whoa, it's you...!
Long time no see!

rows.Speaker: Customer
rows.Line:
Hey, Ken. It's been a while.
I was hoping to talk to you about something... Hm?

rows.Speaker: Customer
rows.Line:
Wait, they're all already here!
Perfect timing!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Hm? Is that customer looking our way?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Huh? Hey, isn't that...

rows.Speaker: Customer
rows.Line:
You're Vivid BAD SQUAD, right?
Mind if I request a song?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Old friend of yours?

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line: Yeah. He worked as sound technician in a live house nearby and we often went for drinks after a show.

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line: He helped me with a lot of stuff when I opened this shop too, like the sound system for the stage area.

rows.Speaker: Old Regular
rows.Line: I was out of the area for work and only came back recently. I decided to go to a live house for the first time in a while and saw you guys perform.

rows.Speaker: Old Regular
rows.Line: You obviously had great potential so I just had to talk to Ken about you guys.

rows.Speaker: Old Regular
rows.Line: I had no idea it was actually you and your friends, An! I thought it sounded like your singing style, but what a pleasant coincidence.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Haha, I've grown up a lot since you last saw me.
Were you surprised to learn it was me?

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line: Her ego's grown a lot bigger too.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Say that again, dad?

rows.Speaker: Old Regular
rows.Line: Haha. You two haven't changed at all.

rows.Speaker: Old Regular
rows.Line: Anyway, mind if I ask you guys to sing something?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
You don't even have to ask!
Alright, everyone! Let's do this!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: His advice is always spot on, so he can definitely help us!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: If that's the case, I don't mind at all. I'm not about to turn down a request from one of Ken's friends.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Yes! Same here!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Same.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Let's see... Then why don't we do that thing we're planning to do for our next event?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Yeah! Maybe we should film it too... This'll be the first time we actually perform it on stage after all.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Dad, can you film us with my phone?
Just press this button once we start.

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line: No problem.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Awesome! Let's make it a good one, guys!

rows.Speaker: Old Regular
rows.Line:
Bravo! Bravo! That was fantastic!
Thank you! You've made my day!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Haha. You're more than welcome!

rows.Speaker: Old Regular
rows.Line: Your voice is so much more powerful than before too, An. Not to mention your stage presence! I couldn't look away!

rows.Speaker: Old Regular
rows.Line: As for you, the versatility of your voice really added depth to the group's performance.

rows.Speaker: Old Regular
rows.Line: And the way you sing sounds emotional, but is actually the result of carefully observing those around you. It provides a good balance for the team.

rows.Speaker: Old Regular
rows.Line: And you... Your voice never wavered even during the difficult parts. This sort of pitch accuracy had to have come from years of hard work.

rows.Speaker: Old Regular
rows.Line: Each member shines in their own way and that's exactly why I'm excited to see how far you can go as a group!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Thanks so much! And we won't disappoint you because we're gonna be the ones to surpass RAD WEEKEND one day. Just you wait!

rows.Speaker: Old Regular
rows.Line: Great! You have my support!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Alright, that's all for today. Remember to meet here instead of at the park tomorrow because we'll be rehearsing with actual equipment.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Got it. Kohane, tell your dad we can't wait to meet him!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: I will! I'll be sure to give him the tickets and event flyer too.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (Maybe I'll do some solo practice after this....)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (Dad's still going to be awake now so...)

rows.Speaker: Old Regular
rows.Line: Oh, hey. Do you have a minute?

rows.Speaker: Old Regular
rows.Line: Yes. I was just wondering... It's unusual for kids your age to sing on pitch so well.

rows.Speaker: Old Regular
rows.Line: Could it be that you have experience with classical music?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Yes, that's right.
I've been doing it since I was little.

rows.Speaker: Old Regular
rows.Line:
I knew it!
It all makes sense now.

rows.Speaker: Old Regular
rows.Line:
Maybe that's why your singing felt...
You know, rigid at times.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Old Regular
rows.Line: I feel like your performance would be more interesting if you tried expressing yourself in your own way a little more, you know...?

rows.Speaker: Old Regular
rows.Line: That said, you should absolutely nurture your existing talents too. Your pitch accuracy is the backbone of the team, so keep working on it!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
I... I see...
Thank you.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (My singing feels rigid...)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Excuse me, Shiraishi.
Can I see the video you just took?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Sure, of course!
I'll send it to you later.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Great, thanks.
Scramble Crossing

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
See you tomorrow, Toya.
Don't practice too hard on your own, okay?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I know. I won't.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: The video Shiraishi sent... Here it is.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (He's right...)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (Akito, Shiraishi, and Azusawa's singing is more free-form and expressive.)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (But mine is...)

rows.Speaker: Toya's Father
rows.Line:
That's not the right rhythm.
Do it again.

rows.Speaker: Toya's Father
rows.Line:
Read the sheet music more carefully and stick to it.
How many times do I have to tell you this?

rows.Speaker: Toya's Father
rows.Line: No deviations whatsoever!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Am I...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Am I being held back by classical music...?
The next day
Weekend Garage

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Hello...

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line: Hey, Toya. You're practicing here today, right? I saved a table for you guys, so feel free to use it.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Thank you very much.
I'll have... Coffee, please.

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line: You got it.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (I've watched that video over and over and my voice is definitely the most rigid in the group...)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (What can I do to change that...?)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Hey, Toya. Sorry I'm late.
The soccer club got their grubby hands on me.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: It's okay...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
What's with the doom and gloom?
Something bothering you again?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Something like that...
I've realized there's a major problem with my singing.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: To be honest, I'm not sure what I can do about it. Can I ask you for your opinion as well? If you don't mind... Hm?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: What's wrong? Why do you look so surprised.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: I wasn't expecting you to just spill the beans like that.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: What do you mean...?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Think about it. You usually clam up when you have a problem.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: And then sink deeper and deeper into self-doubt as you try to solve it by yourself. At least, that's what happened the last time we fought...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Now that you mention it...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: But I guess this means you've sort of fixed that habit.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Looks like it.
It must be because of you, Akito.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Hmph. I'll take that as a compliment.

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line:
Here's your coffee.
Same for you, Akito?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Sure, sounds good. Thanks.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Thank you, Ken.

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line: I used the best beans for this one. The aroma alone can brighten up just about anybody's day. Even yours, Toya.

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line: I don't know what's troubling you, but there's no need to beat yourself up about it.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Ken... You noticed?

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line:
Just a feeling.
Comes with age, you know?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I'm sorry for making you worry...

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line:
It's all a part of life.
So, did something happen?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Well, actually...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Classical music is making your singing too rigid, huh...?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I grew up in the world of classical music after all.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: It's like how classically trained pianists usually can't play swing music well after switching to jazz.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Their minds are so set in their classical background that playing jazzy grooves is just beyond them. So maybe...

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line: You think that might be happening with you as well?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yes...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: There's something different about the way I sing compared to Akito. It's like I can't... Sing freely, maybe?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: That's probably why my style seems so rigid, while my songs sound stale.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: I don't think so...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: I wouldn't team up with someone who could only stick to cookie-cutter patterns.

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line:
He's right.
I agree with him.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: But...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
No, wait...
It has to be true if Akito believes it.

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line: Haha. Your partner has a lot of faith in you...!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Still... I don't know why, but I just feel like I lack that freedom of expression.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: As if I'm still trapped in a sort of classical frame of mind.

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line: Hmm... We think you sound perfectly fine, but if you're convinced there's something wrong with the way you sing...

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line: Then isn't it obvious what the problem is?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line: There's nothing wrong with the way you sing. Something other than classical music is bothering you, right?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Something else...

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line: Looks like you have an idea.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yes. But it's something I believe I've already settled...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Is this about your dad...?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yes... Just the other day, he kept telling me to return to classical music and we ended up arguing over it.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: But I'm determined to continue chasing my dream with you.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Which is why I told my father that I'll never go back to classical music and I'm only going to pursue street music.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: He didn't seem convinced, but there's nothing I can do about that since we have such different values.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: In my opinion, the matter should already be settled...

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line: Hmm...

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line: But maybe it's not quite as settled as you think, Toya?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line: From the way you talk about him, your father must've been a major presence in your life up to this point.

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line: Maybe you're feeling guilty about following a path he disapproves of?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: That's...

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line: That being said, it's not like you can just snap your fingers and make your father understand.

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line: You might as well prepare for the worst and confront him head-on if it's going to bother you like this.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Sorry I'm late!
Hall monitor duties went overtime today.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: I'm sorry for being late too!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: It's fine. We were just having a chat with Ken. Give us a holler once you're ready to start warming up, okay?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Wait, Toya? Are you okay?
You don't look too good...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Don't worry, I'm fine...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Thank you for the advice, Ken.
I'll try to see if there's something I can do.

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line: Sure, but don't overdo it, okay?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I won't...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Oh, about our talk the other day...
My dad said he'd come watch us perform!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: He'll decide whether a live house is dangerous or not after seeing one for himself!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Really?! That's great!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: But you know, he might faint from shock after seeing how awesome you are?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Hehe. That would be a bit embarrassing...
Scramble Crossing

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line: You might as well prepare for the worst and confront him head-on if it's going to bother you like this.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Confront him head-on...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: So this really is about your dad?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yes. I appreciate Ken's advice, but I really don't feel like I can confront my dad about this any further...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
He's always been this wall looming over me.
Something I could never overcome or break down...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Personally, I don't think there's any point in talking to someone who's determined to shoot down everything you say from the start.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I wish it was that easy...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: But if this continues, my problems will affect the whole group.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: So I've decided that I'm going to talk to him today...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Alright...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (Isn't there anything I can do?)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
(No...
Toya needs to do this by himself.)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (If he's already made up his mind, then all I can do is watch from the sidelines.)
Aoyagi Household - Living Room
se_event_nocturne_2021_003

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I'm home...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
(Dad is in the living room...
Okay then...)

rows.Speaker: Toya's Father
rows.Line:
Finally back, huh?
What is the meaning of this flyer, Toya?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
That's the flyer for our next event...
How did you...?

rows.Speaker: Toya's Father
rows.Line: I found it in your room. I can't believe you put something so uncouth on top of your sheet music.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Uncouth...?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I know our music doesn't give people the best impression. One of my teammate's father had the same misunderstanding as well...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
But it's not what you think.
Just come and see for yourself and I'm sure...

rows.Speaker: Toya's Father
rows.Line: Get your head out of the clouds!

rows.Speaker: Toya's Father
rows.Line: You know very well how much value and meaning classical music brings to peoples' lives. I thought I taught you that myself!

rows.Speaker: Toya's Father
rows.Line: And yet you choose to get wrapped up in this...noise! Don't you realize your life is going to become empty because of it?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: My life is...empty?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: You're wrong. My life was empty when I was still doing classical music.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
I was just your slave!
I mindlessly did as you told me to...!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Why won't you understand?!
Why won't you even try to understand...?!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Ugh...!
se_event_nocturne_2021_002

rows.Speaker: Toya's Father
rows.Line: Toya!
Miyamasuzaka

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: *Huff*... *Huff*...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Why dad...? Why...?
The next day
Weekend Garage

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Toya, hold up!
You're supposed to step over there.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Oh. Sorry...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Hey, are you getting tired?
Maybe we should take a break?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: No, I'm fine...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Hm?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (He probably fought with his dad again. He's hiding it pretty well, but his singing tells a different story.)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (Damn it... What should I do?)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Alright, let's wrap up practice for today!
Great job, everyone!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Is it just me or is Aoyagi not feeling very well today, An? He doesn't seem like his usual self...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Yeah...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Toya! You know, you seemed a little out of sorts today. Anything we can help you with?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: A-An?!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: We're a team, aren't we? If something's bothering you, maybe it'd be good to try and handle it together?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
That's...
Well...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: If you don't want to tell us right now, that's fine too. But it would be nice if you could tell us... If you want to, of course...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Look...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: If it's that obvious, then I think they deserve to know about it too.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Akito...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Since it's affecting your singing, this isn't just your problem anymore.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Come on...let us help.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I'm sorry...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Yeah! Don't forget about us!
We'll resolve it faster by doing it together, right?
Go on, tell us what's up!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Two heads are better than one, right?
Sometimes, a bunch of dimwits can outsmart a genius.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Who are you calling a dimwit?
You know our grades are pretty much the same, right?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Quiet, you. No one asked about that.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
I-I'll try to think of something too!
You helped me before, so I want to return the favor!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Hehe...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Thank you. I'd appreciate it...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: This isn't going to be a pleasant discussion, but I would appreciate your input. Are you sure you're for it?

rows.Speaker: Kohane & An
rows.Line: Yeah!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: So you fought with your father...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
He refuses to listen to what I have to say.
He even insists our music is just kids stuff.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Maybe I should just accept the fact that he'll never budge or even meet me halfway...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: You're not good at that sort of stuff either...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: But seriously, why's your dad so stubborn? It's like you're trying to get through to a hunk of rock. Why's he trying to force you back into classical music, anyway?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Wait... Your father's a pretty amazing musician or something, right?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: He's Harumichi Aoyagi, right? I've seen him on TV before. I was so surprised when I found out he was your father.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: He performs overseas as a professional pianist as well, right?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yes. He started his professional career after graduating from a music school in Vienna. In Japan, he's more well-known as a composer.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Whoa... He's really a legit musician, huh?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yes. Dad has only ever cared about classical music as far as I know...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: He taught my two older brothers to pursue the same path. One is also a professional now and the other is currently attending a music school in New York.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: He probably wanted me to follow in my brothers' footsteps too.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: But... I wasn't quite able to do that.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: There's no rule saying you have to become what your parents want. We're not here so they can live vicariously through us.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yes, you're right...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: But the more you talk about your father, the less it seems like we'll be able to convince him...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: How about asking your brothers to talk to him for you?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I did bring it up with them once. Unfortunately, they both respect my dad too much and told me that I was just being naive.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Oh, what about your mother?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: She's also been involved in classical music for a long time and wants me to go back to playing just that.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Hmm... What if I went to talk to him myself?!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: You'd just make things worse...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: But... Isn't there anything we can do...?
Weekend Garage

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Sigh... I've got nothing...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Me neither...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: This is the best us dimwits can do, huh?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Still, thank you all...
For taking this so seriously...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Of course!
That's what teammates are for!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: But let's take a short breather and think about this again later. Hmm...?

rows.Line:
More and more customers are coming in.
We won't be able to dawdle much longer...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Why don't we all go over there for a change?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Over there...? Oh, right! Over there!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Maybe as a container for these sugar sticks...

rows.Line: Miku, what're you doing there?

rows.Line: Remember that cracked cup we found the other day?

rows.Line: I'm trying to think of another way to use it because it would be such a waste to just throw it away.

rows.Line: Hi there, MEIKO!

rows.Line: Yo.

rows.Line: Hey! Welcome back, everyone!

rows.Line:
Rin and Len are out running errands.
Feel free to sit wherever you like.

rows.Line: Are you here to practice today?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: I see. Was it about coming up with a good set list for the event or something?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Oh, no... We were actually talking about me today...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: About you...?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Your dad, huh...?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
That does sound like a thorny issue.
There's not much we can do about it either...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: We know... But we still want to find a way to help, you know?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: That's very like you to feel that way.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
But well...
I didn't know Toya's father was like that.
...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Is something wrong, Miku?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Oh, I was just thinking about something.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Classical music and street music are still both music, right?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: In that case, why does he feel classical music is fine but street music is not?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
He's just being plain stubborn, right?
He believes some music is better than other types of music...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: But Toya's father also loves music as a whole, right? That means we should all be on the same page.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: He loves music...?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Oh, you know what...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: We're trying so hard to think of a way to reach out to Aoyagi's father because we love street music...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: But maybe this is really more of a two-way street?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: How do you mean?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Basically, he's making you play classical music because he loves it and wants you to appreciate it more as well.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Because he loves classical music...

rows.Speaker: Toya's Father
rows.Line: Remember, you were born to play classical music! Why can't you understand what I'm trying to do for you?

rows.Speaker: Toya's Father
rows.Line: Get your head out of the clouds!

rows.Speaker: Toya's Father
rows.Line: You know very well how much value and meaning classical music brings to peoples' lives. I thought I taught you that myself!

rows.Speaker: Toya's Father
rows.Line: And yet you choose to get wrapped up in this...noise! Don't you realize your life is going to become empty because of it?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: My life is going to become empty...?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I get it now. That's what he believes in...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Huh?
Believes in what?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: He believes that classical music is the best way to leave one's mark on life.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: That pursuing and exploring this path is the best way to find happiness... He firmly believes in that.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
He wants me to be happy.
That's why he keeps telling me to go back.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
So what? That's just his opinion.
He has no right to force it on you like that.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: You're the only one who knows what's gonna make you happy.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: That's true, but...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Maybe, from his point of view, I'm deliberately abandoning a path that leads to happiness.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: However...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Just as he believes classical music brings happiness, I believe that our music does the same as well.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: This music was how I met Akito and found my dream.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Which led to us teaming up with Shiraishi and Azusawa.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: It made me believe from the bottom of my heart that singing is fun, and I want to share that feeling.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I firmly believe this music is something I can't live without anymore.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Then tell him that.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I agree.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
You were so cool just now, Toya.
We could all tell how you feel.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Absolutely! I feel like what you just said should get through to even your father!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: You can do it Aoyagi!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Y-You're right...
Nothing will change unless I do something.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I guess moving forward in life takes courage. The courage to keep trying again and again...
Scramble Crossing

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: You gonna talk to your dad again tonight?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I intend to. It's better to do it while I've built up the courage to.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I just hope he finally understands this time...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: I understand...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: I understand how stupidly deep your love of music is.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: When I first found out your reason for singing back then, it sounded so ridiculous that I almost snapped at you.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: But after hearing you sing, I realized how serious you were about music.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Akito...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Besides, think about it.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: After being immersed in music every waking hour of your life, you wouldn't touch it for the rest of your life if you really wanted to get away from it.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: But what you did is different, Toya. You chose to get back into music again...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: You really gotta love music to do that, right?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: What I'm trying to say is... Don't ever forget that.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Sigh...
I don't know how else to put it.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I get it.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I'll never forget how well you understand me, Akito. Not ever.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Got it...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Now, go home and sock it to your dad.
And don't stop until you're satisfied.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I will.

rows.Line: (Dad should be home soon.)

rows.Line:

rows.Speaker: Toya's Father
rows.Line: It's rare to see you home at this hour.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Dad...can we talk?

rows.Speaker: Toya's Father
rows.Line:

Have you finally realized the error of your ways?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: No.

rows.Speaker: Toya's Father
rows.Line: Then there's nothing to talk about...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Please, listen to me.
I need to discuss this with you, dad.

rows.Speaker: Toya's Father
rows.Line: Not backing down so easily today, eh? No matter. I am not about to change my mind...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Dad, I love classical music...

rows.Speaker: Toya's Father
rows.Line: What...?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: To be honest, life hasn't been easy for me because of how strict you've always been. However...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: You also taught me how great classical music can be.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: How different fingering techniques produced different sounds, or how to discern why a composer made a score and where they were coming from... It was exciting.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Above all, I love the way you play the piano.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I wished that I could play as confidently and elegantly as you.

rows.Speaker: Toya's Father
rows.Line: Then why...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: At first, it was just like you said. I wanted to run away.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I couldn't bear the stress of practicing so hard every day. I just wanted to rebel.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: That's why I picked the music genre I thought you would hate the most...

rows.Speaker: Toya's Father
rows.Line:
I thought as much...
I figured it was something foolish like that...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: But then I met some friends who showed me the music I truly wanted to play.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: And the more I sang, the more I came to love street music...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: This is a ticket to our next event.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Please come and listen to my resolve with your own ears.

rows.Speaker: Toya's Father
rows.Line: Hearing something like this isn't going to...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
I know it may seem it's beneath you.
But that's not how I see it.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: This music is as important to me as classical music is to you.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I've never wanted to hold on to something so much before...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: And I really want you to understand that... Because you're the one who introduced me to the joy of music.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I'll be waiting for you...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: And... Thank you very much for teaching me classical music all these years.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: If it weren't for you, I would never have met Akito and the others, or even found my dream.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: So... Thank you, dad.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: That's all I wanted to say. Good night...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Hi, everyone!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Hello, there!
Thanks for dropping by again.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Oh! Len and Rin are here too!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Everyone's here!
Come in and make yourselves at home!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Make yourself at home? This isn't your cafe, Rin.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Hey, that doesn't mean I can't say it!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: How can you two bicker about something like that?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Hehe.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Does this mean everything went well?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yes. I came to let you know...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Hm?
Was this planter here before?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Yup. There was a cup with a crack in it.
So we turned it into a planter.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: As long as it isn't completely broken, you can always use it for something else as long as you don't give up!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
As long as it isn't completely broken, huh...?
I think you're right.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: You know, I feel like I could sing really well right now. Do you mind if I sing something?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Why not? I see no reason to object.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: You're gonna sing? You can't say that without letting me join in!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
What? Akito's gonna sing?
Then I wanna sing too!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Me too, me too!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Get in line, you two.
We're singing first.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Aww... Why can't we all just sing together?
